suppress.notes: Spring Framework 6.2.19 (latest OSS 6.2.x release in Spring Boot 3.5.16): NVD assigns the broad product CPE cpe:2.3:a:vmware:spring_framework:6.2.19 across all org.springframework:spring-* jars for advisories fixed only in Spring Framework 7.0.x / Spring Boot 4 (XsltView, SSE view rendering, WebFlux, RSocket, STOMP). FinSecure Pay is a stateless servlet JSON API (/health, /validate) using none of those features. Formally accepted until 2026-12-31 pending Spring Boot 4 migration. Mirrors .trivyignore.
